title: My World in English
subject: inggris
summary: Colours, body, animals, am/is/are, plurals, prepositions, and a short daily routine.
objectives: name colours, body parts, fruit, and animals
say where things are with in, on, and under
read a short text about a daily routine

sections.title: Words around me
sections.html:
Colours: red, yellow, blue, green, purple, black, white. Body: eyes, nose, mouth, ears, hands, legs. Fruit: apple, orange, banana, grape, pineapple, watermelon.

Say it aloud: "A banana is yellow." "I have two eyes and one nose."

sections.title: am, is, are
sections.html:
to beI am · he / she / it is · you / we / they are

She is a student. They are my friends. I am eight years old.

sections.title: One and many
sections.html: Most words add -s: one book, two books. Some words change: one mouse → two mice, one child → two children, one foot → two feet.

sections.title: Where is it?
sections.html: on the table (on top) · under the table (below) · in the bag (inside) · behind the door (at the back)

sections.title: A day of Tono
sections.html:
Tono wakes up at six. He takes a bath and eats breakfast. He goes to school at seven by bicycle.

Order words help us tell a story: first, then, after that, finally. Try it: "First, I wake up. Then, I take a bath."
